module nvme_command_controller (

    input wire reset,
    input wire [7:0] command_in,
    input wire command_valid,
    output reg command_processed,
    output reg [7:0] command_out
);

              PROCESS = 3'b001,
              DONE = 3'b010;

        if (reset) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            command_processed <= 0;
            command_out <= 0;

                end
                DONE: begin
                    state <= IDLE; // Go back to IDLE after processing
                    command_processed <= 0; // Reset processed flag
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

description:
Create a simple 2-bit branch predictor that predicts whether the next branch will be taken or not based on the current branch outcome. The predictor will use a 1-bit saturating counter for each branch to make the prediction. The state transitions are as follows:
- If the prediction is "taken" and the actual outcome is "taken," stay in the same state (strongly taken).
- If the prediction is "taken" and the actual outcome is "not taken," move to "weakly taken."
- If the prediction is "not taken" and the actual outcome is "not taken," stay in the same state (strongly not taken).
- If the prediction is "not taken" and the actual outcome is "taken," move to "weakly not taken."
The 2-bit counter states can be represented as:
00 - strongly not taken
01 - weakly not taken
10 - weakly taken
11 - strongly taken
code:
module branch_predictor(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire branch_outcome, // 0 for not taken, 1 for taken
    output reg prediction // 0 for not taken, 1 for taken
);
    reg [1:0] state; // 2-bit state
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Initial state (strongly not taken)
            prediction <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin // strongly not taken
                    prediction <= 0;
                    if (branch_outcome) state <= 2'b01; // move to weakly not taken
                end
                2'b01: begin // weakly not taken
                    prediction <= 0;
                    if (branch_outcome) state <= 2'b10; // move to weakly taken
                    else state <= 2'b00; // stay in strongly not taken
                end
                2'b10: begin // weakly taken
                    prediction <= 1;
                    if (branch_outcome) state <= 2'b11; // move to strongly taken
                    else state <= 2'b01; // move to weakly not taken
                end
                2'b11: begin // strongly taken
                    prediction <= 1;
                    if (!branch_outcome) state <= 2'b10; // move to weakly taken
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

    input reset,
    input branch_outcome,
    output reg [1:0] prediction
);

        prediction <= 2'b00; // Initial state

            2'b11: prediction <= (branch_outcome) ? 2'b11 : 2'b10; // Strongly taken
            default: prediction <= 2'b00; // Default case
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
